verdict.rationale: Shopify's Cart MCP documents create_cart, get_cart, update_cart and cancel_cart as JSON-RPC calls against each merchant's /api/ucp/mcp endpoint under the open UCP spec, and create_checkout converts a cart into a checkout session. A runtime probe created a real cart keylessly on Shopify's hardware store via `ucp cart create`. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of update_cart (only cart creation was exercised in the probe).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can create and update a cart or order draft through a documented protocol call

citations.quote: create_cart / get_cart / update_cart / cancel_cart run as JSON-RPC against the merchant's /api/ucp/mcp endpoint
The Cart MCP server enables AI agents to build and iterate on a cart before the buyer commits to purchase.
ucp cart create returned a live gid://shopify/Cart/ id plus the documented next steps (ucp checkout create from the cart id)
the server loads the referenced cart and inherits its `line_items`, `context`, `buyer`, and associated attribution metadata
